label: PF Backlog 518
title: Pipeline Supervisor service + API (status/start/stop): always-on coordinator so enqueued ideas execute
body:
## Problem / why
Enqueued runs (intake/API/CLI) do NOT execute on their own: nothing auto-starts the supervisor (`core/portfolio.run_supervisor`), so jobs sit queued until a human runs `run_portfolio.py start`. There is also no API to observe/start/stop the supervisor.

## Goal & value
An always-on, API-controllable Pipeline Supervisor (a SEPARATE service process) so a submitted idea auto-executes; observable + startable/stoppable via the canonical API.

brief.problem: Enqueued runs never execute without a manually-started supervisor, and there's no API to control it.
brief.what_adds: core.portfolio supervisor status/start/stop + 3 API endpoints; one supervisor service, separate process, guarded by the capacity lock.
brief.why: Make 'submit idea -> it runs' true, and make the executor observable/controllable API-first.

objective: Add core.portfolio supervisor status/start/stop + API endpoints (GET/POST /portfolio/supervisor[/start|/stop]) so the supervisor runs as an always-on separate service, guarded by the existing capacity lock.
acceptance_criteria: start_supervisor() spawns the supervisor as a separate process, idempotent, guarded by can_start_supervisor + lock
stop_supervisor() terminates live supervisor pid(s) gracefully
no dashboard/opencode references; tests cover status/start-idempotent/stop + endpoints
approach: Extend core/portfolio (the owner) with status/start/stop; start spawns scripts/run_portfolio.py start detached (guarded by can_start_supervisor + lock); stop terminates live pids; expose via a new /portfolio router; API-first, no new store/engine.

prior_decisions: API-first; no new store/engine; legacy dashboard frozen
assumptions: one supervisor service; scale via max_supervisors only for HA
API start spawns a guarded subprocess
divergences: new api/ endpoints + spawn (new path, approved)

risks: detached spawn portability (Windows flags); start is idempotent + lock-guarded

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/pipeline_capabilities.py, core/pipeline_composition.py, core/pipeline_executor.py, core/pipeline_store.py
